units.source_text: 有一晚，骤雨滂沱，雷电交作。

en.t: One night, rain suddenly poured down in torrents, with thunder and lightning raging together.

units.source_text: 黎明时分，诸公子及太后的侍从人等都起来看视，

en.t: At daybreak, the young lords and the empress dowager's attendants all got up to see what was happening,
and voices grew noisy, with many eyes and ears all around.

units.source_text: 众侍女惧怕雷雨，也都集中到近旁来。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting, frightened by the thunderstorm, also gathered close by.

units.source_text: 然而无法逃出，只得挨到天明。

en.t: but he could not escape and had no choice but to endure until dawn.

units.source_text: 胧月夜寝台的帐幕外面，众侍女都聚集着。

en.t: Outside the curtains around Oborozukiyo's bed, all the ladies-in-waiting had gathered.

units.source_text: 这一对男女觉得心惊胆战。

en.t: The man and woman were both terrified.

units.source_text: 侍女中只有两人知道此事，然而无可奈何。

en.t: Only two of the ladies-in-waiting knew about it, but there was nothing they could do.
